gates.check: All canonical sitemap URLs return HTTP 200
gates.recovery: Fix failing route/SSR loader and re-run sitemap HTTP crawl.

gates.check: Self-referencing canonical URL matches og:url without trailing slash drift
gates.recovery: Normalize route createSeoMeta(path) and server.js 301 redirect rules.

gates.check: Zero broken internal links and zero dead URLs in llms.txt
gates.recovery: Derive links from central content/simulator registry or update llms.txt.

gates.check: Unique page <title> (<=60 chars) and <meta description> per indexable route
gates.recovery: Remove fallback boilerplate sharing; assign route-specific copy.

gates.check: Consistent Person @id across /, /about ProfilePage, BlogPosting, and Projects
gates.recovery: Point all author/publisher references to https://<domain>/#person.

gates.check: Verified sameAs and rel='me' links with positive disambiguatingDescription (no namesake URL co-occurrence)
gates.recovery: Scrub competing namesake URLs from HTML/JSON-LD; keep positive qualifiers only.

gates.check: Protected routes (/admin, /login, /workspace, /api) excluded from sitemap.xml
gates.recovery: Filter private prefixes in generate-sitemap.js and enforce X-Robots-Tag: noindex.

gates.check: No unintended empty syllabus or stub pages in sitemap
gates.recovery: Mark status:'planned' + noindex or populate units before indexing.

gates.check: All MDX curriculum files compile cleanly during Vite SSR/client build
gates.recovery: Escape currency $ in prose and fence multi-line $$ math blocks cleanly.

gates.check: GFM tables render via remark-gfm without raw pipe characters
gates.recovery: Ensure remarkGfm is loaded in MDX remarkPlugins pipeline.

gates.check: Zero .katex-error nodes and KaTeX MathFormula rendering in FormulaStrip
gates.recovery: Route LaTeX strings through synchronous SSR-safe <MathFormula>.

gates.check: Numerical engineering reference vectors pass in Vitest
gates.recovery: Fix solver equations and re-run Vitest before merge.

gates.check: Every simulator slug and ParametricProblem type exists in lazy/generator registries
gates.recovery: Register missing component/generator and run registry gate test.

gates.check: Zero console.error, pageerror, or SSR hydration mismatch (#418/#419) on key routes
gates.recovery: Fix non-deterministic SSR/client markup and inspect server response.

gates.check: Zero WCAG 2.1 AA contrast or ARIA violations across Dark and Light modes
gates.recovery: Use semantic CSS variables and lock explicit dark panels with .dark.

gates.check: Single <main> landmark, single <h1>, no skipped heading levels, labeled sliders
gates.recovery: Replace inner <main> wrappers with <div> and pass showHeader={false}.

gates.check: Zero horizontal overflow across 360x800, 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900
gates.recovery: Add min-w-0 / overflow-x-hidden constraints on responsive grids.

gates.check: Zero fixed-header occlusion or overlapping floating action buttons (FABs)
gates.recovery: Ensure pt-24/pt-28 below fixed navbar and distinct FAB offsets.

gates.check: Server-side JWT/role verification fails closed (302/401/403) on /admin* and /api/admin*
gates.recovery: Verify identity via verifyCallerIdentity + verifyCallerRole before rendering SSR HTML.

gates.check: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP present
gates.recovery: Deploy Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only first, validate zero blocks, then enforce.

gates.check: LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1, bounded entry JS budget
gates.recovery: Lazy-load heavy 3D/KaTeX/AI bundles and preload hero LCP image.
